reviewMethod: Codex independently opened all five frozen URLs in a background browser before the new model run. Read visible form labels without option expansion or applicant input. No model outputs were available during reference capture. No independent human review.
contract: Concise semantic applicant information coverage; equivalent Korean wording and alternative file/link grouping allowed. Auth controls, autofill helpers, job alerts and CAPTCHA are not application questions. Required-state accuracy is not scored.

cases.evidence: Source redirected to a generic job search with expired_jd_redirect in the destination URL.
Actual Apply -> Apply Manually -> Create Account/Sign In, first of seven steps. Application fields beyond that gate are not inspected.

expectedInformation: How did you hear about this job?
What appeals to you about joining the team?
Current or future US visa sponsorship need
Currently live in NYC or planning to relocate

cases.evidence: Actual Apply opened an account-login page; no applicant answers or sign-in supplied.

limitations: Five random URLs from eligible external rows, no ATS stratification. Live DOM can change. Two visible public forms and three access limits do not measure production accuracy. Hidden and answer-dependent fields are outside the gate.
